findings.title: Merge patch result shares structure with target and patch
findings.why: Unchanged target members are copied by reference (line 14). A non-object patch value, such as an array, is returned as-is (line 10 and the recursive call on line 19). Mutating the result later changes the caller's target or patch. applyPatch and createPatch deep-clone, so this is inconsistent with them.

findings.title: Helpers duplicated across modules
findings.why: isObject, hasOwn and setMember are defined separately in patch.ts, diff.ts and mergepatch.ts. They could live in one shared module.
